sources.title: OmniBioAI/omnibioai-tool-runtime
sources.summary: Minimal cloud-agnostic container execution runtime for the OmniBioAI Tool Execution Service — enforces a strict input/output contract for tools running on AWS Batch, Azure Batch, and Kubernetes. Handles environment injection, output collection, and exit-code-based status reporting with no cloud-specific dependencies in tool images.

sources.title: edwardsdylan84/apex-weather-service-hub
sources.summary: A lightweight web interface designed for monitoring the operational status and health of the Apex weather system. Features customizable status outputs and flexible CSS styling without requiring server-side runtimes.

sources.title: jeremylongshore/cad-ai-agent
sources.summary: Drawing Intelligence Platform for AEC professionals. Upload a DXF, PDF, or DWG — describe what you need in plain English, and get structured edits, compliance reports, quantity takeoffs, health assessments, RFIs, and drawing summaries — all without the AI ever touching your original file.

sources.title: emmmdty/deep-research-agent
sources.summary: Evidence-first research runtime with auditable jobs, claim-level support checks, and report bundle artifacts.

sources.title: vmihalis/hacker-bob
sources.summary: A local MCP runtime that attacks what you own and only reports what it proved. 17 CVEs across 9 projects came out of this repo. Install: npx -y hacker-bob@latest install /path/to/project, then run /bob-evaluate target.com

sources.title: geofreaks/tyrnex-ai-public
sources.summary: Local cyber assessment, triage, topology, and remediation reporting runtime for authorized security reviews.

sources.title: PKU-PILLAR-Group/SafeLens
sources.summary: Pluggable safety analysis infrastructure for LLMs, with unified interfaces for probes, runtime monitors, attribution methods, model loading, pipeline execution, and FlagSafe-compatible reporting. Supports configurable model sources including dummy, HuggingFace, and ModelScope backends.

sources.title: mengchencloud/aws-health-org-api-adapter
sources.summary: A protocol-compatible stand-in for the AWS Health Organization API, for Regions without the Health Organizational View — existing SDK/CLI clients integrate by changing only the endpoint URL. Backed by Lambda + DynamoDB + EventBridge, with SigV4 auth and a web view.

sources.title: coopernathangu4957/clear-disk-metadata-tool
sources.summary: Clear Disk Info v2026 is a cross-platform, read-only disk utility for monitoring storage health, examining volumes, and viewing disk metadata without modifying your drives.

sources.title: pnatlab/mindful-health-balance
sources.summary: A gentle self-care reflection dashboard by MSxAI for tracking hydration, recovery, load, sleep, drinks, and mind state without fear-based health optimization.

sources.title: @babel/plugin-transform-runtime
sources.summary: Externalise references to helpers and builtins, automatically polyfilling your code without polluting globals Current version 8.0.1.
